about: Baked light of the master model for the studio's Exteriér tab and the walkthroughs (bake_exterior.py). Each LM_ mesh's second UV set (uv1) reads its map: linear = sRGB-decoded texel x scale; kind light: colour = base colour x light; kind colour: the colour itself. Trees: light per vertex (COLOR_0 x trees.scale) x their texture. Glass: no map, the sky's reflection. Sky: equirectangular (three.js), x scale. People: cards facing the viewer, feet at p (page coordinates), h tall, w wide.
